name: Kichiku Megane A
source: This game continues the story based on the Bad Ending No. 3 "Result of Sadism" from the original Katsuya x Midou route. The narrative focuses entirely on Saeki Katsuya and Midou Takanori, telling the story of how, after regaining consciousness, Midou loses part of his memory. Katsuya decides to take care of him during this time as a way to atone for his past actions.
translation: 本作延续原作胜也×御堂路线的坏结局3“施虐的结果”。故事完全聚焦于佐伯胜也和御堂孝典，讲述御堂恢复意识后失去部分记忆的经历。胜也决定在这段时间照顾他，以此赎清过去的罪孽。
